mapper.select: SELECT tmp.dockerSum AS dockerSum, tmp.dockerOnLineSum AS dockerOnLineSum, tmp.dockerOffLineSum AS dockerOffLineSum, tmp.dockerUnknownLineSum AS dockerUnknownLineSum, IFNULL(ROUND(tmp.dockerOnLineSum * 100 / tmp.dockerSum, 2), '100.00') AS dockerOnLineRate FROM (SELECT COUNT(1) AS dockerSum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN md.IS_ONLINE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dockerOnLineSum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN md.IS_ONLINE = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dockerOffLineSum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN md.IS_ONLINE IS NULL OR md.IS_ONLINE = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dockerUnknownLineSum FROM MONITOR_DOCKER md) tmp
